newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: A human must confirm that international physical submissions are accepted, select an eligible professionally pressed MarcsMusic CD or LP, approve manufacturing, postage and customs costs, prepare accurate packaging and metadata, verify rights and prior-submission status, and mail manually. deduplication.result: Default-branch repository code search and the complete open pull-request patch were checked for station names, official domains and public Music Department addresses. No previous canonical KVRX or KALX music-submission-agent record was found. Each station is stored once. Digital and physical delivery methods for KVRX are consolidated into one editorial opportunity. KALX's verified Music Department email is not counted as a submission route because its official policy permits physical professionally pressed CDs or LPs only.

notes: Both opportunities are publicly authorized and free-first but remain needs_manual_review. KVRX requires an AI-origin eligibility determination and unconfirmed delivery details. KALX requires physical manufacturing, postage and possible customs handling. No email, form, file, link, attachment, physical package, login, CAPTCHA, consent or payment was submitted or bypassed.
